fact: The document is the full text of the Ethiopian Digital Identification Proclamation No. 1284/2023, a proclamation signed by the President on 18 April 2023 and in force from its publication in the Federal Negarit Gazette (Article 26).

Proclamation No. 1284/2023 sets up a Digital Identification System that collects demographic and biometric data in a central database (Article 2), issues each registrant a unique, permanent, non-repeating Unique Number (Article 11), and provides for authentication online or offline against that database (Articles 2 and 16).
The FaydaVerse director says its work is governed by the Digital Identity Act.

Kana TV News says the Digital Identification Proclamation passed the House of Peoples' Representatives in March 2023 and, as law, bars collection of ethnicity and other data and sets prison penalties of up to eight years for unauthorised disclosure.
